'''Inari Shrine''' (稲成神社) refers to a [[Shinto shrine]] (specifically an [[Inari shrine|Inari Shrine]]). There are three registered [[religious corporation]] under this name.

* [[Taikodani Inari Shrine]] - Located in [[Tsuwano, Shimane|Tsuwano Town]], [[Kanoashi District, Shimane|Kanoashi District]], Shimane Prefecture.
* [[Inari Shrine (Tsuwano Town)]] - Located in Tsuwano Town, Kanoashi District, Shimane Prefecture.
* [[Inari Shrine (Kurume City)]] - Located in [[Kurume|Kurume City]], [[Tanushimaru, Fukuoka|Tanushimaru Town]], Noda, Fukuoka Prefecture.

== Related Items ==
* [[Motonosumi Shrine]] (Yuyatsuo, Nagato City, Yamaguchi Prefecture) - Previously named "Motonosumi Inari Shrine," but it is not a registered religious corporation.
